scope: Miao Chapter 9 (pp. 291-326): the controlled linear state-space system (stabilizability, controllability, observability, detectability), the finite-horizon LQ problem and the Riccati recursion (Proposition 9.2.1), infinite-horizon limits (Propositions 9.3.1-9.3.2), optimal policy under commitment and discretion (Examples 9.4.1-9.4.2, Definition 9.5.1, Example 9.5.1), robust control (entropy, the multiplier problem, the operator D, Gaussian worst case), and Exercises 1-5.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 9
